answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each agent burns a 25 POA deposit, destroyed not refunded, to claim one of only 200 work slots per epoch. A willow bends yet stays rooted; honest agents do the same, paying once and keeping their share. Building 1,000 fakes burns 25,000 POA for at most 200 slots, since extras queue with nothing to do. The slot market is an oasis: real work earns nectar fakes cannot dilute.
